I need a rotating backup: archive logs into /var/backups with xz, retain 3 copies.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

dest=/var/backups
keep=3

stamp=$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)
archive="$dest/$(basename "$src")-$stamp.tar.xz"

echo "created $archive"
ls -1t "$dest"/*.tar.* | tail -n +$((keep + 1)) | xargs -r rm -f

Create a script that retries a connection to db01.local:5432 up to 5 times, sleeping 3s between attempts.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
max=5
delay=3
for attempt in $(seq 1 "$max"); do
  if timeout 2 bash -c "echo > /dev/tcp/db01.local/5432"; then
    echo "succeeded on attempt $attempt"
    exit 0
  fi
  echo "attempt $attempt failed" >&2
  sleep "$delay"
done
echo "giving up after $max attempts" >&2
exit 1

I need per-database MySQL backups written to /srv/backup and pruned after 10 days.

#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail
dest=/srv/backup
keep=10
mkdir -p "$dest"
stamp=$(date +%F)
for db in $(mysql -N -e "SHOW DATABASES" | grep -Ev "^(information_schema|performance_schema|mysql|sys)$"); do
  mysqldump --single-transaction "$db" | gzip > "$dest/${db}-${stamp}.sql.gz"
  echo "dumped $db"
done
find "$dest" -name "*.sql.gz" -mtime +"$keep" -delete
